intent: Original modular scenery, generated from written descriptions informed by design references 13, 24 and 25. Source artwork is used byte-for-byte. Asset rectangles are mapped to world geometry by the Godot renderer.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Ultra-wide 3:1 cinematic panorama for ONE original 2D orthographic black-ink pixel-game far background, designed to scroll once continuously left to right without tiling. Entire plate one scene: silent night blue charcoal sky accounting for upper 45%, faint scattered small stars, layered elongated ink and thundercloud banks, silhouettes of foothills in lower 35%, distinct dark tall East Asian pine canopies with a stronger silhouette on far left, middle is valley with layered bluish haze and flat river fog along the bottom third, right has a few distant rugged peaks but soot-blue forest ridges in front. Trees gradually change with x, naturally lopsided and no obvious symmetry or center. Colors ink-black, near-black desaturated navy, mineral cold gray-blue, very slight violet in clouds. Premium hand-dithered pixel game craft, large shapes with exceptionally fine deliberate pixel cluster shading, visual depth, humidity, no noise abuse, dark graduated midtones, quiet haunted atmosphere. No plateau or visible ground, structures, silhouettes of people, lights, moon, sun, text, separators, empty borders, collage, or UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one modular 2D pixel environment tileset, a full wide horizontal image with three horizontal RECTANGULAR BANDS stacked top to bottom with exact equal height; y=0 to 33.3%, y=33.3% to 66.6%, y=66.6% to 100%. Bands meet with no margin or separator. Each band goes from the exact left edge to the right edge. A game will take each band as a repeated side-view building-interior backdrop crop, so no sloped perspective, no side wall or central hero framing, and do not put tall dominant features across crop boundaries. This is an original late Qing Chinese ancestral shrine in inkshadow pixel style, damp near-black aged black lacquer wood, smoked chestnut and cinnabar only as restrained accents. Top band: series of connected rear walls of the public entry hall with a variety of rectangular dark lattice screens, paper smoky windows, a couple of long closed cabinets to the wall. Middle band: second-floor gallery wall of ancestor alcoves and alternating black wood lattice windows and small carved wooden plaques without markings. Bottom band: hidden rear register archive backing wall with shelves full of handmade dark-red ledger bindings and bundled folios, small blank niches, a worn silk hanging and a few black drawers. Frontal orthographic at unit scale; the rear wall reaches the boundary, the lower 15% of each band is mostly empty skirting and very dark wood so game actors can be seen in front. Subtle ash-blue night from the windows, slightly warm ambient chestnut lacquer without any bright pools or baked visible lamps; lamp props will be separate. Rich individually grouped pixel detail, hand-clustered and sharply resolved shading, very dark palette with enough midtone to see material, exceptionally premium multi-layer game-set craftsmanship. No people, creatures, weapons, animated effects, text, labels, blank border, entire building exterior, staircases, furniture off the wall, roof tiles, or UI. This single output is a production texture plate divided only by subject matter into three continuous bands.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original production texture sheet for a high-end 2D dark pixel-art game in a humid antique Chinese temple. Landscape rectangle. It has exactly four equal-height edge-to-edge HORIZONTAL texture bands with HARD STRAIGHT borders at 25%, 50%, 75% of full canvas height; no margins or markers. Fill each row from the exact left edge to right edge with continuous medium-scale pattern designed to horizontally repeat; no objects larger than the row, and continuous edge character. Row 1 top, black blue-slate wet rectangular stone flags on an oblique ground strip with pixel-edge specular streaks, dark puddle joints, subtle rust-red highlights, never bright white or blue. Row 2, a vertical dark antique Chinese boundary wall of irregular shale bricks and vine shadows with a dark flat stone cap, side-on wall surface. Row 3, glancing dark cherry-black long lacquer floorboards, damp amber wear in ridges, moderate contrast, no text. Row 4 bottom, soot-black row of tight historic dark clay Chinese barrel roof tiles, tiny slate light ridges, brown wood fascia across bottom, continuous horizontal array of tiles with no curvature at either side. Pixel-art pixel-cluster craftsmanship at one-to-two-pixel pattern scale, not photorealistic, crisp, damp and understated. Palette ink-black, misty charcoal teal, dark chestnut, hints of dried vermilion, reflections only where wet. Textures neutral dark enough for live actors in front. No symbols, people, objects, gold foil, ornate Qing palace, ceiling, labels, visible dividers or UI. Art fills entire rectangle all edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE true transparent-background 2D environment sprite atlas of exactly 12 independent game props in a strict 4 columns by 3 rows grid with equal-sized cells and generous transparent padding; each prop center stays within central 75% of its cell and is cleanly separated from all others. Landscape wide sheet. Objects, left to right: first row [a full-height closed heavy black-lacquer double temple door with dark bronze hinge studs and thick black wood frame; second similar dark aged heavily broken split wooden door leaning jagged stumps on two sides of an open doorway; tall sculptural black-lacquer Chinese main temple timber column with square grey stone plinth and mortised capital; one small antique hanging hexagonal Chinese lantern with restrained warm amber light and metal cap]. Second row [wide low black wood altar table with upright incense vessel and three modest thin sticks; low tea table with worn wood and legs; shrine register wooden desk with a plain open cream-paper folio, black lacquer, bronze corner wear; three-point Chinese wooden hinged chevaux-de-frise barricade of damp dark wood and wrought pins]. Third row [a short stone stone-well rim with age; one folded crate of aged wood with iron straps; dark Chinese timber lattice screen window, square, smoked reddish wood; freely suspended black temple bell with uniquely shaped rim]. Side-view straight front or a hint of bevel only, grounded foot anchors, exquisitely realistic pixel craftsmanship: hard pixel clusters, visible wet stains, wood grain, metal dull highlights, carved joinery, very modest contrast and broken edges. Rich depth without smooth brush painting. Palette bone grey, midnight blue, charred wood, dark cinnabar plus warm localized amber lantern. No humans, decoration icons, lettering, HUD, fake checkerboard, fantasy glyphs, tiles behind props or labels. Transparent background everywhere outside all twelve object silhouettes. No props cross cell boundaries.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-ready 2D game environment sprite on genuinely transparent background. An entire extraordinarily wide, shallow traditional late Qing Chinese ancestral temple roof along the very top of the building, visible in strict frontal orthographic side elevation. The full roof is centered and isolated, left and right complete, main eave forms the long straight bottom edge. Black-glazed curved ceramic pan tiles in individually discernible staggered rows, small aged ridge beasts as low silhouette shapes, raised swallowtails curling upward at both outer edges, small dull-red silhouette trim under the eaves, finely carved aged chestnut wooden fascia, copper-dark nailheads and contrasting wet blue-grey surfaces. The middle half must consist entirely of plain continuous regular tile rows and eaves so that game assembly can crop the edges and insert more repeat roof tiles there. Roof proper has aspect roughly 7:1, finished bottom fascia level. Transparent all around, including above, ends and underneath. Do not include the building, roof pillars, walls, figures, furniture, ladders, scenery, moon, light halos, any text or symbol, or concept montage. Nothing touches the frame. Black lacquer and charcoal under a little cold cloud-light, exceptionally premium hand-dithered charcoal ink pixel art with clustered hard one- to three-pixel shapes. Readable outline primarily in cool slate rimlight, no colorful decorated palace or anime shine.

Use case: stylized-concept. Output exactly one dark damp STONE PAVING TILEABLE TEXTURE PLATE, ultra-wide panorama approximately 3:1, no separate panels. A cobbled walking surface of a late Qing Chinese ancestral temple courtyard photographed from side-profile game angle with a slight overhead view, entire image is seamless wet SMALL ash-blue and sooty charcoal brick pavers, about thirty individual blocks along the width and at least six separate rows vertically. Actual medieval laid stone sizes are fist- to foot-wide; rows stagger. Unequal hand-worn edges, tiny cracks between individual pavers, uneven rivulets and crack moss, faint blue-green sky reflected in recesses, traces of oxidized dried red earth in a few joints. Large faint near-black puddle patches over multiple bricks, never chrome, rain, foamy water, blue neon or bright spotlights. Dark contrast with exceptionally sharp 2D clustered pixel technique at one-relative-pixel scale; each stone subtly distinctive, no uniform noise. Pure texture, no road curvature, vanishing point, objects, person, wall, horizontal bands, labels or other elements. Broad horizontal pattern with similarly shaded endpoints for seamless assembly. Ground texture is an actual game component, not a completed scene illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE transparent alpha sprite showing only a small approx 1:1 round pale moon in a dark East Asian ancestral shrine pixel-art videogame. A round low-contrast gibbous near-full moon, crater and basalt maria softly grouped and cool, hand-pixel shaded and finely dithered, dim offwhite as seen through humidity, medium-to-low contrast. Moon centered, small negative transparent margin, no outer bloom or glow, no background, no stars, no flowers, no figure, no type, no frame, no other sprites. Absolutely genuine transparency outside the moon silhouette. Game will downsample to 55 world pixels, emphasize three or four natural broad craters rather than beautiful detailed optical photography or stencil-flat cubes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single production game environment texture for a side-on Chinese ancestral shrine. Deliver an ultrawide 3:1 horizontal texture, a continuous EMPTY expanse of rain-wet ancient stone courtyard paving ONLY, edge to edge. Every pixel is the WALKING SURFACE. Viewed at a shallow downward angle, like a hand-crafted dark fantasy pixel-art side-view battlefield, no vanishing point or centered path. Broad staggered rows of small worn rectangular brown-black granite and bluestone bricks, visibly interlocking horizontal seams, rough chipped bevels picking up warm copper sunset-lantern light from the right and restrained cool silver moon reflections at left; 22 to 32 stones across, around 18 horizontal courses high, compact fine pixels, localized little puddles, reflected glints following mortar, irregular warm grey/brown wet finishes and crisp pixel clusters. Far edge stones visibly shallower and darker than near edge. A quiet dark adult supernatural mood with readable medium-value stone, no pitch black foreground. No walls, sky, horizon, pillars, weeds, structures, people, props, flames, glyphs, border, interface or lettering. No vertical stone faces; no roadway receding through center. It will tile sideways behind 80 pixel tall sprites.
